brand.purpose: Service name in the page header — strongest type on screen.

title.purpose: Nav tile titles, row titles, dialog headings.

body.purpose: Descriptions, form help, list secondary lines.

shadows.name: none-at-rest
shadows.purpose: Default for lists, tiles, cards, toolbars.

motion.name: color-transition
motion.purpose: Default state changes for hover/focus fills and borders.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Clay fill action; min 40px tall for tablet taps.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; min-height: 40px; align-items: center; border: none; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--primary, oklch(0.58 0.15 42)); color: var(--primary-foreground, oklch(1 0 0)); padding: 10px 16px; font: 500 0.875rem/1.25 Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.9; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--bg, #fff), 0 0 0 4px var(--ring, oklch(0.58 0.15 42)); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; min-height: 40px; align-items: center; border: 1px solid var(--border, oklch(0.91 0.006 85)); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--bg, oklch(1 0 0)); color: var(--ink, oklch(0.22 0.02 50)); padding: 10px 16px; font: 500 0.875rem/1.25 Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--surface, oklch(0.975 0.004 85)); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--ring, oklch(0.58 0.15 42)); }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Standard form field with clay focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; border: 1px solid var(--border, oklch(0.91 0.006 85)); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--bg, oklch(1 0 0)); color: var(--ink, oklch(0.22 0.02 50)); padding: 10px 12px; font: 400 0.875rem/1.4 Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--muted, oklch(0.48 0.02 50)); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: var(--primary, oklch(0.58 0.15 42)); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring, oklch(0.58 0.15 42)) 30%, transparent); }

components.name: Primary Chip
components.css: .ds-chip-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--primary-soft, oklch(0.96 0.03 42)); color: var(--primary, oklch(0.58 0.15 42)); padding: 2px 8px; font: 500 0.75rem/1.3 Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Nav Tile
components.description: Home destination tile — places to go, not content cards.
components.html: OrdersCreate and track event orders
components.css: .ds-nav-tile { display: flex; min-height: 56px; align-items: center; gap: 16px; border: 1px solid var(--border, oklch(0.91 0.006 85)); border-radius: 12px; background: var(--bg, oklch(1 0 0)); padding: 16px 20px; text-decoration: none; color: inherit; transition: border-color 0.15s ease, background-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-nav-tile:hover { border-color: color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary, oklch(0.58 0.15 42)) 30%, transparent); background: var(--surface, oklch(0.975 0.004 85)); } .ds-nav-tile:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--bg, #fff), 0 0 0 4px var(--ring, oklch(0.58 0.15 42)); } .ds-nav-tile-icon { display: flex; width: 48px; height: 48px; flex-shrink: 0; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--primary-soft, oklch(0.96 0.03 42)); color: var(--primary, oklch(0.58 0.15 42)); transition: background-color 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease; } .ds-nav-tile:hover .ds-nav-tile-icon { background: var(--primary, oklch(0.58 0.15 42)); color: var(--primary-foreground, oklch(1 0 0)); } .ds-nav-tile-copy { display: flex; min-width: 0; flex: 1; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; } .ds-nav-tile-title { font: 600 1rem/1.4 Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--ink, oklch(0.22 0.02 50)); } .ds-nav-tile-desc { font: 400 0.875rem/1.4 Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--muted, oklch(0.48 0.02 50)); } .ds-nav-tile-chevron { flex-shrink: 0; color: var(--muted, oklch(0.48 0.02 50)); transition: transform 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease; } .ds-nav-tile:hover .ds-nav-tile-chevron { transform: translateX(2px); color: var(--primary, oklch(0.58 0.15 42)); }

components.name: List Surface
components.description: Bordered list shell with row dividers — no shadow.
components.css: .ds-list { margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; border: 1px solid var(--border, oklch(0.91 0.006 85)); border-radius: 12px; background: var(--bg, oklch(1 0 0)); overflow: hidden; } .ds-list-row { padding: 14px 16px; font: 400 0.875rem/1.4 Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--ink, oklch(0.22 0.02 50)); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border, oklch(0.91 0.006 85)); } .ds-list-row:last-child { border-bottom: none; }

components.name: Back FAB
components.description: Fixed home path — 48px circle with soft blur veil.
components.css: .ds-back-fab { display: inline-flex; width: 48px; height: 48px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--border, oklch(0.91 0.006 85)) 50%, transparent); border-radius: 9999px; background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--bg, oklch(1 0 0)) 30%, transparent); color: var(--ink, oklch(0.22 0.02 50)); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-back-fab:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--bg, oklch(1 0 0)) 50%, transparent); } .ds-back-fab:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--bg, #fff), 0 0 0 4px var(--ring, oklch(0.58 0.15 42)); }

narrative.overview:
This is the visual system for a tablet-first catering operations tool. Screens should feel like a calm kitchen desk on an iPad: soft, touch-forward controls, pure white working surfaces, and one clay terracotta accent that marks action without decorating the room. Density stays low; every screen has one job.

The system rejects marketing landing-page aesthetics (hero metrics, gradient text, cream/sand backgrounds), dense desktop-only admin panels, and hamburger-only navigation without a clear path home. Brand shows in the page header name and the terracotta mark — not in hero copy or campaign chrome.
keyCharacteristics: Pure white canvas + soft surface tint; restrained clay terracotta accent
Geist sans throughout; brand name outranks page title
Flat at rest; light lift only on dialogs and floating actions
Large tap targets (40–48px) for gloves / wet hands
Navigation tiles are destinations, not content cards

rules.name: The One Clay Rule
rules.body: Clay terracotta occupies ≤10% of any screen. If a layout feels “branded orange,” pull color back into buttons, chips, and the header mark only.

rules.name: The Kitchen Contrast Rule
rules.body: Ink on white is the default reading pair. Do not lighten muted text further for “elegance.”

rules.name: The Brand-First Header Rule
rules.body: The catering service name stays larger/stronger than the current page title. Never invert that hierarchy.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: No decorative drop shadows on content. If it looks like a SaaS dashboard card stack, remove the shadow and keep the border.

dos: Do design for iPad Safari / home-screen first: large tap targets (≥40px, prefer 44–48px for primary actions).
Do keep brand name visually above page title in the header.
Do use clay terracotta for actions, focus, and scarce status — not for backgrounds.
Do prefer bordered list shells and nav tiles over elevated cards.
Do keep ink-on-white as the default reading pair for kitchen / outdoor readability.
donts: Don't use marketing landing page aesthetics (hero metrics, gradient text, cream/sand backgrounds).
Don't build dense desktop-only admin panels as the primary layout.
Don't ship hamburger-only navigation on mobile without a clear home path back.
Don't add side-stripe (border-left accent) decorations or gradient text.
Don't stack nested cards or decorative multi-layer shadows.
Don't shrink controls below glove-friendly tap size to “fit more on desktop.”
